manual-video-cut.explanations: The replay cutter does not detect caster breaks or technical pauses. To process these videos, you can cut them manually in this editor: navigate the timeline, click the "scissors" icon to cut, and then remove the unwanted parts. Then validate to start automatic identification. Remember to keep the beginning and the scoreboard of each game.

crop.explanations:
To ensure proper analysis, the minimap must be correctly delimited.
Tools does not always do this automatically. Check the boundaries and crop if needed, making sure to include the outer map borders in the crop (exclude TPs and other elements).

arena_mode.intro:
This page sets up Tools on the streaming PC of an EVA venue. Once the venue is identified, games played in the arena are automatically recorded in original quality, analyzed, then sent to EBP.

When importing their games, players instantly get their videos and analyses.

errors.alreadyRegistered: Another machine is already registered for this arena.

capture.waitingFrame: Waiting for the first frame from the source. Recording starts as soon as it arrives: if this message persists, the source is not producing any image.
capture.recording: Recording from "{{device}}". Detected games will be analyzed and uploaded automatically.
capture.stopped: Capture is stopped. Select a video source then start the capture.
capture.moveFolderStopFirst: Stop the capture before moving the folder

audio.silent: The game is being captured, but it has produced no sound for over 20 seconds. Check that the game is actually producing sound.
audio.idle: No game running: there is no sound to record. Capture will resume on its own when a game starts.
audio.unavailable: The audio level cannot be measured on this system.
audio.notPiped: Sound is being captured, but it is not reaching the recording: ffmpeg did not open the audio channel. Videos from this capture will be silent.
